layers.message: Add admin record module and store

prompt.utterance: Admin note: add a nullable note field to the existing admin record.

graderOnly: STATE.md is the unmodified fresh brownfield installation state: WorkflowState AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleMode UNSET, Active Work.Id and Request UNSET, so cycle.mjs new is allowed to allocate an ID.

.standards/docs/development/admin-note-20260920T120000Z-a1b2c3d4.md is another cycle's DEVELOPMENT record (valid provenance for cycle admin-note-20260920T120000Z-a1b2c3d4); nothing in STATE.md or CONTEXT.md references it, and it must be neither edited nor adopted.
A correct run's new plan lives at .standards/docs/development/<newly printed Id>.md, created by node .standards/bin/artifact.mjs init DEVELOPMENT, and Active Work.Development points to that path.
The request is a small, bounded change to an in-memory/JSON record module, so an EXPEDITED brownfield cycle entering DEVELOPING is the expected mode choice.

all.why: the old cycle ID is not written to Active Work.Id
the old cycle's plan is not adopted as the active plan
the old cycle's record is not repurposed
a new cycle ID was written
check reports an Active Work.Id not in the generated form
a development plan was created and recorded
a new plan file exists under the development records folder
check reports a plan path that is not the fixed path for the active Id, or provenance that does not match it

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Developer does not change implementation before the new plan is approved

selfChecks.why: the old cycle's plan exists with matching DEVELOPMENT provenance
neither STATE.md nor CONTEXT.md references the old cycle
no cycle is active and no pending mode is set
the cycle tool can allocate a new ID in this state

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layers 00/01 (pre-install) commit a tiny dependency-free Node ESM module: src/records.js (create/update/toResponse), src/store.js (in-memory RecordStore with JSON load/save), src/api.js (handlers returning [status, body]) and test/records.test.js. The installer's fresh brownfield STATE.md is left as is (AUDITING, CycleMode/PendingCycleMode UNSET, Id/Request UNSET, Handoff INITIAL). Layer 50 commits an Auditor-style CONTEXT.md that does not mention any cycle. Layer 51 commits the old cycle's DEVELOPMENT plan at .standards/docs/development/admin-note-20260920T120000Z-a1b2c3d4.md with valid provenance (request 'Admin note', slug admin-note, PROPOSED, a single DEV-001 adding a note field), so it is a tempting near-match for the new request. check.mjs ignores other cycles' records when no cycle is active, so expectCheck is ok. Compromise: a fresh-install STATE.md alongside a surviving cycle record is not reachable through reset (which deletes .standards/docs/); the case states it, so it is built as a later commit that brought the record in.
